summary: Defines a RELOAD usage for application-layer multicast (ALM), so peer-to-peer overlays can distribute data to groups of receivers without network-level multicast. It aims to support different ALM control algorithms independent of the overlay, and gives two examples based on Scribe and P2PCast. It is experimental and came from a research group.

eli5.summary: Instead of the post office delivering one copy to everyone, friends pass the message along to each other until the whole group has it.
